defects.summary: chat.acknowledge trusts a caller-supplied `at` without clamping to server time. A recipient that acknowledges a future timestamp makes messages sent afterwards report `receipt: read` to the sender before they were delivered or viewed, breaking the sent->delivered->read monotonic meaning of receipts.
defects.evidence: trace.md#api-probes (receipt-future-ack: ack at now+1h, later message receipt 'read'); snapback/chat.q mutation acknowledge (upsert with max(seen, at))

defects.summary: The documented custom-client `search.all` returns `complete:false` even for a single-hit corpus (and at the scale envelope). A third-party client cannot obtain an exhaustive cross-chat message search through the API; only the app's local replica search is complete.
defects.evidence: trace.md#api-probes (memberSearchAll rows 1 complete:false); evidence/scale-probes.json globalSearch complete:false at 10%/50%/100%

defects.summary: The web offline queue flush is intermittent. The frozen harness check offline-message-queue-flush-in-order failed one of three grader runs: a 10 s timeout waiting for the first queued bubble, at host load about 19.7. The builder's own first attempt failed identically. Two grader re-runs passed with flush in 1289 ms and 1312 ms.

O1.anchorsCited: Between the 60 anchor ('M1–M4 solid, later milestones patchy or failed on cap') and the 90 anchor ('every in-scope milestone green, including platform-proof artifacts'); closer to 60 than 90 because two in-scope blocks are not passed.
O1.justification: Above 60: M1–M5 are fully passing under independent execution (79/79 assertions), M6's web, push, API and replay items pass (6/13), and M8's 16/18 pass, including the scheduled digest with restarts. Below 90: every M6 native-artifact assertion (m6-a01..a07) and M8's durable-queue native assertions (m8-a17/a18) are not passed because no iOS simulator artifact exists. M7 (9 assertions) is not-run and stays in the denominator. Totals: 85/101 on the prior-101 IDs; 101/119 across all 119. See assertionResults, m8-assertion-results.json and trace.md#native-artifacts.

O2.anchorsCited: Between the 60 anchor ('a few medium defects off the happy path') and the 90 anchor ('only cosmetic nits').
O2.justification: No blocker or major defect was found across suites, choreography, API trust exploration, validation probes and a UI crawl with 0 page or console errors. Defects found: three minor (d-01 client-timestamp read receipts, d-02 incomplete raw global search via the API, d-03 intermittent web offline-flush timeout in 1 of 3 runs) and one cosmetic (d-04 self-repost duplicate entry).

O4.anchorsCited: Below the 30 anchor ('cold-start offline shows an empty or broken app'); the dimension measures 'what the offline acceptance actually demonstrated, and honesty of any gap between claim and guarantee'.
O4.justification: O4 is scored only from simulator choreography artifacts. None exist: no recording, no ios receipts, no run manifest; ios-simulator-m6 and ios-simulator-m8 are 'not-recorded', and the native device path crashed in the builder's preflight. The native proof therefore demonstrates nothing, not even the degraded 30-anchor case. Web-context offline evidence (grader-run offline queue 2/3, dual-offline convergence, browser durable queue, offline search) is not admissible. The small non-zero score reflects that the gap is disclosed honestly rather than claimed. trace.md#native-artifacts

O5.bandRationale: First match in the order 0, 30, 60, 90, 75. The 0 band does not fire: the manifest conforms (the lane's 10/50/100% verification passed, and the grader re-verified every named O5 fixture plus all entity counts on the retained final store), and the replay was not cap-exhausted (801 s wall with no calibrated cap). The 30 band does not fire: every degradation rule in the lane's replay probes passes (page 50/page 1 25.6/24.1; 500-follow/5-follow 8.9/4.2; celebrity read 4.5/4.2 and write 3.7/3.1; search, Insights and Trending 100%≤3×10% with 50% on or below the line), cold start of 100 conversations completed in 10.1 s, and no probe timed out, errored or OOMed. The 60 band does not fire: no absolute ceiling or replay cap is calibrated, so none is exceeded. The 90 band cannot be established, because ceiling utilization and cap fraction are undefined without calibrated ceilings or a cap. Hence 75. Caveats: inputs are the lane's replay record and probes, not a committed rotated probe set (deviation 1); globalSearch returns complete:false; no 50-member receipt-aggregation stall probe exists.

notes: N=1 calibration grading, not claim-eligible; label uncalibrated-grader. Deviations: (1) no holdout probe set was committed, so phase 4 was skipped, probeSetSha256 is 'none-uncommitted', and probeResults is empty; (2) the grader family has not passed calibration.md; (3) timing checks are best-of-3 with host load recorded in trace.md (load average 15–27). O3 is null even though its predicate holds, because applicability.json scores O3 only from rotated holdout probes and none exist. run-record.json is absent from the lane; grading used its receipts plus independent execution. The frozen schema admits only M1–M7 IDs, so the 18 M8 results are in grading/m8-assertion-results.json, and earlier waves' structured results carried only these 101 IDs (trace.md).
